project_context.name: eğitim.today İçerik Atomizasyon & Otomatik Yayın Platformu

design_system.theme: Dark Theme (Notion + Linear mix). Ambient accountability, high density.

typography.heading: Cabinet Grotesk
typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use tight tracking for headings > 32px. Use wide tracking (0.1em) and uppercase for overlines/labels.

colors.rules: No drop shadows. Use 1px borders to define shapes. Background must be deep obsidian, not pure black. Text contrast must pass APCA.

design_system.grids: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full on children.

layouts.sidebar: Fixed width, distinct background (#0A0A0B), 1px right border.
layouts.header: Sticky top, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F1011]/80) or solid #0F1011 with 1px bottom border.
layouts.kanban: Flex horizontal scroll. Columns have min-width. Items stretch.
layouts.atom_preview: Bento style or vertical feed. Exact platform mockups using custom HTML/Tailwind.
layouts.calendar: Dense data grid. Use subtle borders for cell division.

motion.hover: transition-colors duration-200. Elements should shift background color slightly.
motion.drag: Scale up (scale-105) and increase border opacity.

design_system.accessibility: Use data-testid on all interactive elements. Ensure focus rings are visible (ring-2 ring-[#5E6AD2]). Contrast ratios above 4.5:1.

component_usage.cards: Flat, border-border, no shadow. p-6 padding inside.
component_usage.buttons: Radius 6px. Primary uses accent color. Secondary is surface color with border.
component_usage.inputs: bg-surface border-border. Text secondary when empty.
component_usage.badges: Small, uppercase, tracking-wide. Colored based on status.

login_bg.description: Abstract dark texture for login or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create all components in JavaScript (.jsx / .js). DO NOT USE TypeScript (.tsx / .ts).
Build the UI entirely in Turkish as requested.
Apply the 'Linear' aesthetic: deep dark #0F1011 background, flat cards with 1px borders, no drop shadows, and #5E6AD2 as the accent color.
Add Google Fonts 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Headings), 'Manrope' (Body), and 'JetBrains Mono' (Stats/Logs) to index.html.
Design the Kanban Review Queue using raw HTML/Tailwind with a horizontal flex layout.
For the Atom Preview cards, build precise mockups resembling Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram using custom Tailwind classes.
Include an Observability section (Jobs/Logs) using JetBrains Mono for the text to give it a technical feel.
Never use 'transparent' background for dropdowns or modals. Always use #191A1B with a border.
Use standard HTML inputs customized via Tailwind if Shadcn is missing, but prefer Shadcn components customized to look flat.
Use framer-motion for drag-and-drop or mockup transitions if applicable.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and border colors.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where scrolling content requires it (e.g. sticky header).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Specify properties (e.g. `transition-colors`).
MUST NOT center align the app container. Remove `.App { text-align: center; }` from CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add `data-testid` attribute to all interactive and key informational elements.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
